description: This file defines the RefRadioIms class, which extends the RadioIms class to implement specific IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) radio functionalities, including setting call info, updating registration, starting/stopping traffic, triggering fallback, sending query, and updating call status.

classes.name: RefRadioIms
classes.description: A class extending RadioIms to provide specific implementations for IMS-related radio functionalities.

methods.name: setSrvccCallInfo
methods.description: Sets the SRVCC call information with a list of SRVCC calls.

methods.name: startImsTraffic
methods.description: Starts IMS traffic with specified parameters.

methods.name: stopImsTraffic
methods.description: Stops IMS traffic for a given token.

methods.name: triggerEpsFallback
methods.description: Triggers EPS fallback with a specified reason.

methods.name: sendAnbrQuery
methods.description: Sends an ANBR (Adaptive Network Bandwidth Request) query.

methods.name: updateImsCallStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of IMS calls.
